summary: QuotientIQ V5 testing complete. All 5 V5 feature areas verified end-to-end: (1) Industry templates — GET /api/industries returns 5 industries (hvac/plumbing/auto/law/real_estate) with id/name/tagline/agent_count, POST /api/industries/{id}/install creates bundled agents, merges company profile without clobbering existing non-empty fields, returns 404 for unknown id, returns 402 when trial expired. (2) Trial: /api/billing/me reports trial_days_remaining (12-14 for fresh users) and is_active=true; paid plans (starter/professional/enterprise) return 9999. (3) Paywall enforcement: setting trial_started_at to 20 days ago triggers 402 on POST /api/agents and POST /api/industries/install; bumping user.plan='starter' unblocks both. (4) Team: GET /api/team returns org members; admin/owner POST /api/team/invite accepts {admin,manager,employee}, rejects 'owner' (400), rejects invalid roles (400), rejects duplicate invites (400), DELETE /api/team/{email} removes member, non-admin users get 403 on invite & remove. (5) Audit logs: agent.create, industry.install, team.invite/remove, api_key.create/revoke all written, GET /api/audit-logs returns user logs sorted desc with action filter working. (6) API keys: POST /api/keys returns raw qiq_ key ONCE, list returns prefix-only (no raw), API-key auth on /api/agents works, revoked key returns 401, creating/revoking keys WITH api-key auth returns 403, revoking unknown id returns 404, unknown qiq_ token returns 401. Regression: all 47 prior tests still pass. Total: 66/66 pytest in ~50s. Frontend: sidebar workspace group renders nav-team/nav-billing/nav-audit/nav-developer; /marketplace shows industries-section + 5 industry-card-{id} with install-industry-{id} buttons; HVAC install succeeds; /team page shows invite-form (invite-email/invite-role/invite-submit), invited member appears in list; /audit shows audit-list (31 rows) + audit-filter; /developer create-key-form returns raw qiq_ key in new-key-display with copy-new-key, key-row-{id} + revoke-key-{id} work. Trial banner correctly hidden for admin (plan=free but days>=7 or trial_started_at >14d in past). All data-testids spec-compliant.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1530+ lines. The industry templates dict (INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES) sits inline at ~100 lines; consider extracting to /app/backend/industry_templates.py. Same for team/audit/keys routers — modularization is overdue.

POST /api/industries/{id}/install has no idempotency — calling it twice from the UI creates duplicate agents (observed: admin now has 2 sets of HVAC agents on dashboard). Consider checking for existing agents from same industry or returning a confirmation.
TrialBanner.jsx hard-codes a session-level dismiss (useState). Across page reloads it re-appears every time. Consider sessionStorage to persist dismissal within the tab.

API key create response leaks the raw key only in the response body, which is correct. However, /api/keys list endpoint includes 'active' field, but the DELETE /api/keys/{id} hard-deletes the doc (delete_one) rather than setting active=false. This means revoked keys are gone forever — fine for security, but loses audit trail of which keys existed. Suggest soft-delete (set active=false) to preserve history and make GET /api/audit-logs more meaningful for api_key.revoke entries.

get_current_user: when an API key is invalid AND a cookie/JWT exists, the code falls through to cookie auth. Spec says 'using a revoked or non-existent key returns 401' — this is correct only if there's no other auth on the request. Worth documenting this behavior or rejecting any 'Bearer qiq_*' header that doesn't resolve before trying fallback.
Industry install loop inserts agents one-by-one (await per insert). For 4-6 agents that's fine, but bulk_insert_many would be faster.

team/{email} DELETE path-encodes the email but doesn't lower() before deleting against the pull (it does .lower() in invite but not delete). The route param 'email' arrives as-is — minor case-sensitivity risk on remove.
